entities.name: Fluorophenyl thiazolylpiperazine
observations: Search result identifies the supplied reactant as 2-(4-fluorophenyl)-4-(piperazin-1-yl)thiazole; SMILES Fc1cccc(-c2csc(N3CCNCC3)n2)c1.

entities.name: Pyridazinyl carbamate
observations: Supplied activated carbamate is reported as O=C(Nc1cccnn1)OCC(Cl)(Cl)Cl, with a 2,2,2-trichloroethyl leaving group.

entities.name: Pyridazinyl urea product
observations: Exact-match reaction record reports product O=C(Nc1cccnn1)N1CCN(c2nc(-c3cccc(F)c3)cs2)CC1, formed by replacing carbamate OCH2CCl3 with the piperazine nitrogen.

entities.name: Carbamate aminolysis
observations: Piperazine secondary NH attacks the heteroaryl carbamate carbonyl and displaces the 2,2,2-trichloroethoxy group, giving an unsymmetrical urea under DIPEA/DMSO/water conditions.
